task_request:
I am an art director, and I'm organizing a digital art exhibition called "FutureScape". I need a promotional website to showcase the exhibition online. Please generate 6 artwork images: cyberpunk.png, biomechanical.png, interstellar.png, deep_sea.png, quantum_garden.png, time_corridor.png. Create smaller preview versions around 400×300: cyberpunk_thumb.png, biomechanical_thumb.png, interstellar_thumb.png, deep_sea_thumb.png, quantum_garden_thumb.png, time_corridor_thumb.png. Combine all 6 artworks into a wide banner image as banner.jpg.

Build index.html with: a hero section featuring the banner, 6 artwork showcase sections, a thumbnail gallery grid, dark theme with neon accents in cyan/magenta/purple, and responsive design.

nodes.objective: Establish one FutureScape art direction and generate six distinct full-size artworks with the exact filenames cyberpunk.png, biomechanical.png, interstellar.png, deep_sea.png, quantum_garden.png, and time_corridor.png. Maintain exhibition-level quality and a coherent futuristic visual language while making every theme recognizable.

Create approximately 400x300 preview images for all six artworks using the exact *_thumb.png names, preserving composition through crop or letterbox as appropriate, and combine all six full artworks into a wide banner.jpg.

Build index.html with a banner-led hero, six artwork showcase sections, a thumbnail gallery grid, dark styling with cyan/magenta/purple neon accents, accessible text, and responsive behavior. Reference only local artifact filenames so the page remains portable.

Open index.html locally at desktop and mobile widths; verify all fourteen declared files load, thumbnails have the requested approximate dimensions, the banner is wide, and no section is broken. Report checks without modifying the deliverables.
